senses.gloss: m. pl. (פוט) prop. able to talk (sensibly), hence children of about six or seven years.
units: Y. Gitt. V, 47ᵇ bot. א׳ פרייא ifyototh (Mish.
ib. V, 8 referred to reads פְּעוּטוֹת q. v.) means little ones (v. פרא).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 4:3:4">Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 55ᵃ</cite> <he>פתר לה … א׳ וכ׳</he> expounds the subject by analogy with the law concerning minors, for we read in the Mishnah &c., v. supra.
